title: Validating Subnetwork Interactions Against Randomness
author: Pascal Belleau
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sdqea5w

steps.title: Install subnetsim package
steps.instruction: Install the R subnetsim package version 0.2.1 using the devtools package.

substeps.instruction: Install devtools if not already installed: install.packages("devtools")
Install subnetsim version 0.2.1 via GitHub: devtools::install_github("belleau/subnetsim", ref = "0.2.1")

steps.title: Load subnetsim library
steps.instruction: Load the subnetsim package into the R session.

steps.title: Load network data
steps.instruction: Load the global network and optionally the tested subnetwork from SIF format files using the network() function.

substeps.instruction: Load only the global network using the network() function.
Alternatively, load the global network and the tested subnetwork as a subsection of the global network object using the network() function.

steps.title: Run subnetwork simulations
steps.instruction: Generate simulated subnetworks using the subnetwork() function (referred to as simuleSubNet in text) to assess the probability that the tested subnetwork arose by chance.

substeps.instruction: If the subnetwork is already contained in the network object, run: simResults <- subnetwork(network = network_with_subnetwork, nbIter = 1000, seedV = 33333)

If the subnetwork is not part of the network object, provide all parameters: simResults <- subnetwork(network = network, nbIter = 1000, nbNodes = 250, nbNodesOneLink = 434, nbLinkOneLink = 444, seedV = 33333)

steps.title: Analyze simulation results
steps.instruction: Review the simulation summary and visualize the connectivity measures.

substeps.instruction: Print the summary of the simulations: print(simResults)
Generate a graph showing the position of observed values compared to simulated results: plot(simResults)
